Package pt.pa.controller.featureTab

Enum Class FeatureTab

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<FeatureTab>
pt.pa.controller.featureTab.FeatureTab
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<FeatureTab>, Constable
public enum FeatureTab extends Enum<FeatureTab>
Represents the tabs indexes and its corresponding fxml file names. This enum allows the easy mapping of tab indices to their respective FXML files, which can be used for dynamic UI loading and management.
